name: @projexlight/connector-hubspot
summary: Bidirectional HubSpot connector: OAuth install + bind contacts / deals / companies to their ProjexCloud counterparts, push lead scores + engagement events back, ingest HubSpot Webhooks for real-time triggers. Sits next to connector-salesforce so a tenant on HubSpot gets the same RevOps story.

hooks.name: registerBinding
hooks.description: Wire a ProjexCloud entity → HubSpot object binding.

hooks.name: handleWebhook
hooks.description: Verify + ingest a HubSpot Webhook payload.

scenarios.title: Tenant connects HubSpot via OAuth
scenarios.when_to_use: Admin clicks 'Connect HubSpot' on the connectors page; we exchange auth-code for refresh token + record the portal.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Install row + vault-wrapped refresh token. Emits .install.created.v1.

scenarios.title: Push ProjexCloud lead-scores into HubSpot custom property
scenarios.when_to_use: RevOps wants lead-scores on every contact card. Bind sdk-lead-scoring → HubSpot Contact projex_lead_score custom property, refresh every 15 min.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Binding active; per-15-min sync pushes scores. Conflicts logged with rowcount in sync_run.

scenarios.title: Inbound: 'deal.creation' webhook fires downstream
scenarios.when_to_use: HubSpot fires a webhook on every deal creation; sdk-notification + sdk-projection react instantly.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Signature verified; event committed + emitted. Downstream consumers react within seconds.

scenarios.title: Daily pull of HubSpot contact changes
scenarios.when_to_use: Daily delta sync for analytics — pulls every Contact modified since last sync into the read-through cache.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Binding row; pull sync hydrates connector_hubspot.hubspot_contact daily. sdk-analytics can join against it.

scenarios.title: Scheduler keeps OAuth refresh tokens fresh
scenarios.when_to_use: OAuth refresh tokens expire if unused; the scheduler periodically refreshes so a quiet tenant doesn't end up with a dead install.
scenarios.example_code: // driven by startScheduler — refreshes installs that haven't synced in 24h.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Each install refreshed in the background; install row updates with new expires_at. No tenant-visible action needed.

compliance_posture.notes: OAuth refresh tokens vault-wrapped. Webhook signatures use HubSpot's v3 signature scheme with timestamp replay-window protection. EU portals pinned to EU API endpoints for residency.
